cautions: A containing function can inline a named setter; it is not automatically the implementation.
Minimum-size references and matching names do not authorize writes.
Mask agreement verifies storage layout only; choice labels, global side effects, pointer ownership and UI companion changes require separate evidence.
APPEARANCEDATA offsets are not player-record offsets.
No new runtime address or enum label is recommended.
